methods_quotes.q: Two data sources were examined: a survey of clinical laboratories conducted during January–March 2014 and surveillance data during January 2012–December 2013.
Incidence was calculated using U.S. Census estimates of the surveillance area populations for 2012 and 2013.
Because there were few differences between 2012 and 2013 data, this report combines surveillance data for both years.
